comment: Variation of in_or_out_menu-escape-quits-looting-first-of-two-sacks: a debug-mode gnomish Wizard with lootabc drops three sacks and #loots all of them. At the first menu, 'n' toggles off the preselected 'loot next container' row (n == 0 with more containers: 'n', pickup.c 3476); at the second, ESC (n == -1) quits although a third sack remains.
